title: Acceptance probability of a nonzero linear predicate
statement: Let $r$ be a nonnegative integer, and let a predicate specify a linear equation over $\mathbb F_2$ in $k$ variables, where $1\le k\le r$, with any right-hand side in $\mathbb F_2$. For uniformly random values of those variables, the equation holds with probability $1/2$.
